labs.title: Array: Minimum, Maximum, and Sum
labs.goal: Single pass over input data, boundary cases, and avoiding int overflow.
labs.description: Read n integers from standard input (n from 1 to 100). Print the minimum, maximum, and sum separated by spaces. Store the sum in a long variable.
labs.inputFormat: First line is n, followed by n integers separated by spaces or newlines.
labs.hint: Read the first element as the initial value for min, max, and sum; process the remaining n - 1 numbers in a loop.

labs.title: User Directory Lookup
labs.goal: Domain modeling, Map indexing, and explicit handling of missing keys.
labs.description: Read n lines formatted as id;name;true|false (IDs are unique and positive), followed by a target ID. If the user is active, print their name; if inactive, print INACTIVE; if missing, print NOT_FOUND.
labs.inputFormat: First line is n (0..100), then n lines of id;name;active, and the last line is the target ID.
labs.hint: Store User objects in a Map<Integer, User>; split(";", -1) parses each line, then check for null before checking active.

labs.title: Data Import: Resilient Parsing on Bad Input
labs.goal: String parsing, input validation, and handling errors without crashing.
labs.description: Read n lines formatted as name,age. A line is valid if the trimmed name is non-empty, there is exactly one comma, and age is an integer in 0..120 inclusive. Skip invalid lines. Print the count of valid records and the sum of their ages.
labs.inputFormat: First line is n (0..100), followed by n lines of name,age.
labs.hint: Use split(",", -1), check array length == 2 and non-empty name; catch NumberFormatException when parsing age.

labs.title: Orders: GROUP BY Without a Database
labs.goal: Aggregate sums by ID, filter groups, and output in deterministic sorted order.
labs.description: Read n orders formatted as userId amount, followed by a threshold. Sum amounts per user in a long, keep users whose total >= threshold, sort by ascending userId, and print id:total separated by commas without spaces (or - if none match).
labs.inputFormat: First line is n (0..100), then n lines of userId amount, and the last line is the threshold.
labs.hint: Use TreeMap<Integer, Long> or sort keys before building the comma-separated result.

labs.title: Mini HTTP Request Router
labs.goal: Route HTTP methods and paths, validate numeric path parameters, and return status codes.
labs.description: Read n lines formatted as METHOD /path. Route GET /health -> 200 OK, POST /users -> 201 CREATED, GET /users/{id} (where id is a positive 64-bit integer) -> 200 USER {id}, and everything else -> 404 NOT_FOUND.
labs.inputFormat: First line is n (1..100), followed by n lines of METHOD /path.
labs.outputFormat: n lines with the response status and payload.
labs.hint: Check exact matches first, then handle prefix /users/ and validate that the ID is a positive Long.
